correctness.rationale: Full proof: Jacobian rank below three iff at most two coordinate values; the first two weighted-moment equations force support weight zero unless the total coefficient weight vanishes. On nonzero total weight the Hessian of F3-(3/2)F2 restricted to F1,F2 tangent directions, modulo scaling, is nondegenerate, so singularities are reduced ordinary double points. Codimension and normality follow from isolated singularities of a positive-dimensional complete intersection. Exhaustive finite-field projective-point checks passed in three examples; these do not replace the uniform proof.
